seo_title: Short-Form Video Strategy Course | Reels & Shorts | Nova Skills
seo_description: Learn Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts strategy, hooks, content calendars and analytics in 5 weeks (40h). Build a campaign playbook. ₹6,900.

overview.heading: What You Will Learn
overview.description: Learn to plan strategic Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts for creators and brands. Develop skills in audience research, content pillars, hooks, short-form storytelling, campaign planning, publishing workflows and performance analysis using realistic creative briefs and practical experiments.
expandedCopy: Plan short-form campaigns that have a purpose, not just a posting schedule. Learn how to research audiences, develop content pillars, script Reels and Shorts, organize publishing and evaluate performance. Build a complete strategic playbook that includes twenty video ideas, eight creative briefs, three prototypes and an evidence-led optimization roadmap.

Understand the key differences between Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts discovery ecosystems. Move past algorithmic myths to test genuine creative hypotheses, analyze engaged views, stayed-to-watch metrics, and retention drop-offs, and deliver client-ready campaign strategies.
overview.differentiation: Learn to Plan and Evaluate Short-Form Campaigns—not Simply Edit Individual Videos.
overview.learningJourney: Understand the Audience → Define the Goal → Research Opportunities → Plan Content → Brief Creatives → Prototype → Publish When Authorized → Measure → Learn → Improve
corePrinciples: Content growth is a disciplined process of audience relevance, original creativity, distribution and learning—not a universal algorithm hack.
A rough video prototype demonstrates strategic direction; professional post-production video editing is covered separately in Course 71.
Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts operate on different discovery algorithms, user consumption habits, and metric definitions.
August 2026 YouTube view counting starts when playback begins; engaged views and retention patterns provide the true measure of viewer impact.
No universal three-second rule: hooks are audience-specific creative decisions, not rigid algorithmic secrets.
TikTok remains restricted in India; training focuses strictly on accessible, compliant platforms (Reels and Shorts).
Public publishing is optional; staged and private campaign submissions receive 100% assessment credit.

required: Familiarity with viewing short-form vertical videos on Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts
Basic computer literacy and willingness to conduct online audience research and write video briefs
recommended: An active Instagram account and YouTube channel for observing content patterns
system_requirements: Standard computer or laptop with internet access for research, drafting, and spreadsheet planning
Smartphone capable of viewing Reels and Shorts
not_required: No video editing experience or paid editing software (e.g., Premiere Pro) required
No camera gear, studio lighting, or expensive microphones required
No TikTok account or CapCut installation required (not mandatory in India)
Public publishing is never compulsory—private/staged campaign submission is 100% accepted

best_for: Social Media Managers & Content Strategists planning short-form video campaigns
Brand Marketers & Small Business Founders building organic video presence
Agency Creative Directors & Copywriters writing video scripts and briefs
Content Creators & Video Producers transitioning from random posting to structured strategy
Freelance Marketing Consultants offering Reels and Shorts campaign planning
not_for: Students looking for advanced video editing, motion graphics, or visual effects certification (Course 71)
Individuals seeking overnight viral follower hacks, engagement pods, or bot services
Those looking for full-scale Meta Ads Manager or Google Ads media-buying engineering
who_should_take_foundation_first: Learners completely unfamiliar with using Instagram or YouTube as regular viewers.

learning_outcomes: Distinguish Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
Distinguish reach, engagement and conversion objectives.
Distinguish engaged views from raw views.
Present a strategy to a client.

core_platforms: Instagram Professional Dashboard & Insights (Reels Analytics & Account Overview)
YouTube Studio (Shorts Content Analytics, Engaged Views & Retention Curves)
Meta Business Suite (Supported Reels Publishing & Content Scheduling)
supporting_tools: Google Sheets (Editorial Calendar, 20-Idea Bank & Measurement Frameworks)
Google Trends (Topic Demand, Regional Context & Audience Interest)
Canva (Visual Creative Boards, Scene Layouts & Storyboard Mockups)
Optional ChatGPT / Gemini (Ideation & Outline Assistance with Mandatory Human Review)
india_platform_policy: TikTok remains restricted in India and is NOT mandatory for any classroom assignment or portfolio deliverable.
Accessible, approved local and international tools (Reels and Shorts) serve as the primary teaching foundation.
tools_to_avoid: Engagement Pods & Reciprocal Inauthentic Activity Services
Automated Comment Bots & Follower Purchase Tools

faq.question: What is Short-Form Video Strategy & Content Growth?
faq.answer: It is an applied strategy course covering Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, audience research, content planning, creative briefing and analytics.

faq.question: How long is the course?
faq.answer: Five weeks with 40 learning hours.

faq.question: What is the course fee?
faq.answer: ₹6,900, subject to verified Nova Skills pricing and tax policy.

faq.question: Is the course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes, for learners familiar with Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts.

faq.question: Do I need video editing experience?
faq.answer: Basic editing literacy is helpful but professional editing expertise is not required.

faq.question: Is this a video editing course?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on strategy, planning, briefing, distribution and performance analysis.

faq.question: Which platforms are taught?
faq.answer: Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts are the mandatory platforms.

faq.question: Is TikTok required?
faq.answer: No. TikTok remains restricted in India and is not a mandatory learning tool.

faq.question: What is a content pillar?
faq.answer: A recurring content theme that connects audience interests with a creator or brand's objectives.

faq.question: How many content pillars will I create?
faq.answer: Three main content pillars.

faq.question: How many video ideas are required?
faq.answer: Twenty researched ideas.

faq.question: Will I create a publishing calendar?
faq.answer: Yes, a 30-day content calendar.

faq.question: Will I write video scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. Eight detailed scripts or production briefs are required.

faq.question: Will I create actual videos?
faq.answer: The portfolio requires three rough or completed creative prototypes, not eight professionally edited finished videos.

faq.question: Will I learn video hooks?
faq.answer: Yes. You will develop audience-relevant openings and understand their creative purpose.

faq.question: Is there a universal three-second hook rule?
faq.answer: No. Different audiences, topics and platforms require different creative approaches.

faq.question: Will I learn Instagram Insights?
faq.answer: Yes. The curriculum covers relevant Reels performance metrics and limitations.

faq.question: Will I learn YouTube Shorts Analytics?
faq.answer: Yes, including engaged views, Stayed to watch and retention.

faq.question: What are engaged views?
faq.answer: Engaged views represent continued viewing beyond initial seconds according to YouTube's current reporting definitions.

faq.question: How are YouTube views counted in 2026?
faq.answer: Since August 24, 2026, YouTube's public view counting starts when playback begins across supported formats.

faq.question: What is skip rate?
faq.answer: It describes early skipping behaviour, with specific definitions and availability depending on the platform or tool.

faq.question: Does Instagram Edits show skip-related insights?
faq.answer: Meta introduced skip-rate-related feedback in Edits. The exact feature availability and presentation should be verified.

faq.question: Will I learn content testing?
faq.answer: Yes. Students prepare meaningful creative variations, hypotheses and realistic evaluation plans.

faq.question: Must I publish content to pass?
faq.answer: No. Simulated publishing workflows and staged campaign plans are accepted.

faq.question: Do I need an Instagram business account?
faq.answer: Not for every course assignment. Authorized examples and sample datasets can be used.

faq.question: Is Meta Business Suite included?
faq.answer: The course introduces applicable publishing and management workflows where supported.

faq.question: Will I learn Meta Ads?
faq.answer: Only the distinction between organic and paid objectives. Full advertising operations are outside scope.

faq.question: Can AI help with scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. AI can assist with ideation and drafting, but all claims and creative decisions require human review.

faq.question: What will my portfolio include?
faq.answer: Audience research, three pillars, twenty ideas, a 30-day calendar, eight briefs, three prototypes, measurement and a four-week optimization roadmap.

faq.question: Who should enroll?
faq.answer: Social media managers, agency creatives, marketers, founders and creators who want to plan and evaluate short-form campaigns. ---
